content.doc_md:
❮ Arrays Methods

Thesort()method sorts an array in 
ascending order.

This method sorts arrays of strings alphabetically, and arrays 
of integers numerically.

Java Arrays Tutorial

### Code Snippets

```
Example
Sort an array of strings alphabetically:
String[] cars = {"Volvo", "BMW", "Tesla", "Ford", "Fiat", "Mazda", "Audi"};
Arrays.sort(cars);
Try it Yourself »

---

Example
Sort an integer array numerically:
int[] myNum = {50, 10, 25, 1, 17, 99, 33};
Arrays.sort(myNum);
Try it Yourself »

---

Example
Sort an integer array numerically, but only sort from index 1 to 3:
int[] myNum = {50, 10, 25, 1, 17, 99, 33};

// This will only sort the integers 10, 25, 1 and 17 from the myNum array
Arrays.sort(myNum, 1, 4);
Try it Yourself »
```
